curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who overrides signs, then what each sign shape and color means.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each color and shape and its meaning.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions matching colors and shapes to sign purposes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast stop and yield signs, then walk through railroad warnings from advance sign to gates.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on stop, all-way, yield and each railroad sign and signal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions at stop signs, yield signs and railroad crossings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Describe the diamond warning signs and what each asks the driver to do.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each warning sign's meaning.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on warning sign meanings and responses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover speed, lane, passing, prohibition and parking signs.
Explain work zone signs and flaggers, the slow-moving vehicle emblem, and route and guide signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on work zone signs, special emblems and route markers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on work zones and route and guide signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through each light, arrow and flashing signal, then failed signals and pedestrian signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each signal and what it requires.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on signals and all-way stops.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain yellow and white lines, passing rules, crosswalks, stop lines and lane arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each marking and what it allows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on lines, passing and lane arrows.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
